title: DevSuperSuite & OmniKernel 5.2-LTS Enterprise 90-Day Onboarding Milestone Checklist

milestones.milestone_name: Architectural Discovery & Monorepo Topology Mapping
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Complete audit of monorepo languages, repository sizes, LSP configs, and baseline LLM API token spend across OpenAI, Anthropic, and existing cloud proxies.
milestones.remediation_protocol: If token telemetry is fragmented across multiple billing accounts, ingest consolidated monthly invoice exports.

milestones.milestone_name: Enterprise Golden Image Creation & Cryptographic Signing
milestones.acceptance_criteria: DevSuperSuite-Enterprise package authored and signed for Jamf Pro (macOS), Microsoft Intune (Windows 11), and Ansible/Nix (Linux) with offline Ed25519 licensing.
milestones.remediation_protocol: If corporate code signing certificate is missing, utilize internal PKI / Sigstore Cosign airgap keys.

milestones.milestone_name: Air-Gap SCIF Network Verification & eBPF Socket Audit
milestones.acceptance_criteria: In-kernel eBPF socket monitoring module attached to sys_enter_connect; 72-hour continuous soak test executing with exactly 0.00 KB outbound WAN transmission.
milestones.verification_command_or_script: bpftool prog load enterprise_airgap_ebpf_monitor.o /sys/fs/bpf/scif_monitor && dmesg | grep 'SCIF_EGRESS_VIOLATION'
milestones.remediation_protocol: If unmonitored UDP DNS packets are observed, enforce pfSense drop rule SCIF_DEV_DENY_ALL_WAN.

milestones.milestone_name: TPM 2.0 Hardware PCR Quote Attestation Baseline
milestones.acceptance_criteria: TPM 2.0 PCR registers (0, 7, 10, 14) recorded and signed by Attestation Identity Key (AIK); local offline verification operational.
milestones.remediation_protocol: For legacy workstations without discrete TPM 2.0, fall back to Apple Silicon Secure Enclave or Nitro Enclaves.

milestones.milestone_name: Fleet-Wide Central Git Invariant Pre-Commit Hook Deployment
milestones.acceptance_criteria: AgentShield pre-commit hooks enrolled in global git template directory, enforcing Shannon entropy threshold (H >= 4.50) and test suite preservation.
milestones.remediation_protocol: If developers bypass pre-commit with --no-verify, enforce identical validation in CI server-side pre-receive hooks.

milestones.milestone_name: 10% Innovation Fleet Enrollment & Kickoff Seminar
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Deploy DevSuperSuite to 10% pilot engineers (10 to 500 devs); conduct 60-minute live onboarding seminar with hands-on CLI walkthrough.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Provide recorded asynchronous video modules for distributed teams across different time zones.

milestones.milestone_name: AST Context Slicing Baseline Validation (-83.6% Token Reduction)
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Measure prompt token count across 500 active sprint queries; confirm reduction from ~4,280 to ~702 tokens per query (-83.6% reduction).
milestones.remediation_protocol: If token reduction falls below 80%, refine Tree-sitter query patterns for language-specific private block types.

milestones.milestone_name: DevEx Latency & Silicon Memory Footprint Verification
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Verify OmniKernel resident set size (RSS) remains under 150 MB and AST parse latency executes in under 1.5ms on host hardware.
milestones.remediation_protocol: If host has disabled AVX-512 in BIOS, enable AVX-512 extensions or fall back to AVX2 optimized SIMD paths.

milestones.milestone_name: Pilot Retrospective & Formal Expansion Approval
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Compile pilot survey results; confirm >95% developer satisfaction and formal executive sign-off for full fleet rollout.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Conduct 1-on-1 technical sessions with any dissenting developers to address workflow-specific questions.

milestones.milestone_name: Wave 1 Fleet Rollout: Core Backend Services (25% Fleet)
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Automated push via Jamf/Intune enrolling 25% of fleet; zero reported IDE regressions or build interruptions.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Roll back specific squads via Jamf smart group scoping if local environment conflicts arise.

milestones.milestone_name: Wave 2 Fleet Rollout: Frontend & Mobile Squads (50% Fleet)
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Enrollment reaches 50% fleet across React, Next.js, Flutter, and iOS/Android teams; AST TypeScript/Swift slicer active.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Ensure Swift and Kotlin Tree-sitter parsers are pre-compiled and bundled in golden image.

milestones.milestone_name: Wave 3 Fleet Rollout: DevOps, SRE & SCIF Enclaves (75% Fleet)
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Deployment to air-gapped SCIF workstations and defense aerospace pods via optical data diode transfer.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Validate physical media hashes with FSO before transferring across SCIF security perimeter.

milestones.milestone_name: Hands-Free Duplex Voice Coding Enablement Masterclasses
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Host global workshops teaching sub-110ms duplex voice coding, ONNX Silero VAD, semantic AST commands, and 'CROW' barge-in.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Distribute pre-configured noise-cancelling headset recommendations for high-density open-plan offices.

milestones.milestone_name: Wave 4 Fleet Rollout: 100% Full Fleet Deployment Complete
milestones.acceptance_criteria: 100% of engineering fleet actively equipped with DevSuperSuite; central config synchronized.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Target remaining offline or vacationing machines with scheduled Intune retry profiles.

milestones.milestone_name: Legacy Cloud SaaS Subscription Decommissioning
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Cancel recurring monthly subscriptions for Cursor ($20/mo) and Copilot ($19/mo); revoke OAuth tokens.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Verify that all developer configurations have cleanly migrated to local OmniKernel MCP provider.

milestones.milestone_name: Ergonomic Wellness & RSI Impact Telemetry Analysis
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Quantify developer wellness metrics: confirm >30% reduction in keystroke fatigue and 42 minutes/day saved focus time.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Share customized ergonomic workflow profiles with high-volume committers.

milestones.milestone_name: Engineering Balance Sheet Financial Audit Execution
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Extract LLM API provider usage logs; verify direct cash savings of $35,616 per 100 developers across the 90-day window.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Cross-reference API invoice line-items with internal query logging timestamps.

milestones.milestone_name: AgentShield Incident Review & Security Audit Certification
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Audit log confirms 100% interception of staged secret keys and autonomous agent test deletion attempts; 0 regressions.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Update custom company entropy whitelist for any newly introduced mock testing patterns.

milestones.milestone_name: Executive QBR Presentation Deck Production
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Finalize 10-slide C-level executive presentation deck incorporating empirical enterprise metrics, charts, and ROI models.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Schedule dry-run briefing with VP of Engineering prior to C-suite delivery.

milestones.milestone_name: Executive Business Review (QBR) Presentation to C-Suite
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Deliver 45-minute QBR briefing to CIO, CTO, CISO, and CFO; review verified $1.42M net savings and sub-21-day amortization.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Deliver formal written responses to any specialized CFO tax depreciation or accounting inquiries.

milestones.milestone_name: Perpetual Operations Hand-Off & SLA Ratification
milestones.accountable_stakeholder: VP of Engineering & Director of Platform
milestones.acceptance_criteria: Execute formal Perpetual Operations Certification (DSS-POC-2026); enroll organization in quarterly optical diode update schedule.
milestones.remediation_protocol: Establish designated enterprise support Slack/Teams channel and ticket routing queues.
